name: SRC-[DLP] Block Source Code Uploads
description: Blocks uploads containing Python, JavaScript, or shell-script source code to AI/ML applications. Application scope is resolved from the tenant's AI_ML catalogue at deploy time.

name: SRC-[DLP] Block Source Code Uploads [Endpoint]
description: Endpoint DLP: the same detection as the inline rule "SRC-[DLP] Block Source Code Uploads" (SRC-CSharp, SRC-CPlusPlus, SRC-Go, SRC-HTML, SRC-Java, SRC-JavaScript, SRC-Kotlin, SRC-Python, SRC-Rust, SRC-SQL, SRC-Swift, SRC-TypeScript, SRC-VBNet). Monitor-only; enable after reviewing incidents.
